title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ（千石靖研究室）
subtitle: Design Project III(Sengoku Yasushi)
educationalGoal: In this course, each student will be tasked with finding a unique theme related to Media Informatics, thinking about the problem scientifically, and then proposing and implementing a solution. As a result, students can be expected to gain knowledge necessary for becoming creative engineers by embodying project design methods that are based on the conceive-design-implement-operate (CDIO) cycle using the knowledge they have acquired so far.
advice:
In Design Project III, each student will work on a unique theme based on the lessons of the first to third years of study with the Department of Media Informatics.

Students will practice problem-finding and problem-solving techniques, and then produce deliverables based on the advice and guidance of their faculty advisers.

Students will be expected to learn techniques for finding, investigating, and solving problems in specialized areas based on the knowledge and skills of the specialized subjects that they have studied thus far.

The primary theme of this laboratory is the construction and evaluation of the following systems:
antivirus, measures against unauthorized access, e-commerce, copyright protection, etc.

Learning tips:
Students will need to be fully self-managed in order to work on project themes and achieve results.
Students will need to acquire the skills and knowledge necessary for the theme proactively.

activityGoals.body: Be able to learn the basics of creative engineering using problem-finding/solving techniques.
Be able to explain matters related to their specialization.
Be able to deepen their understanding of "engineer ethics."
Be able to apply their expertise to project themes.
Be able to conduct research and development on the project theme using the CDIO cycle.

Students will practice problem-finding and problem-solving techniques, and then produce deliverables based on the advice and guidance of their faculty advisers.

Students will be expected to learn techniques for finding, investigating, and solving problems in specialized areas based on the knowledge and skills of the specialized subjects that they have studied thus far.

The primary theme of this laboratory is the construction and evaluation of the following systems:
antivirus, measures against unauthorized access, e-commerce, copyright protection, etc.

Learning tips:
